studyflow.legalDraft: Preview text — the owner must approve legal terms before launch.
studyflow.termsBody: {appName} is a personal learning workspace. In this preview, all accounts and actions are simulated in your browser. Before launch, final terms must define eligibility, acceptable use and account deletion.
studyflow.privacyBody: Your study notes and files are private. The platform admin sees study statistics. Content access is reserved for documented abuse or legal investigations and is logged. This preview stores mock data in your browser. The final policy must specify launch countries, age rules, retention and contact details.
